product.name: Monoprice Commercial Series Heavy-Duty Long Pole Ceiling Mount for Landscape Displays Fits 43 to 86 TVs
product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series Heavy-Duty Long Pole Ceiling Mount for Landscape Displays, Fits 43-86in TVsThe Monoprice Commercial Series Heavy-Duty Long Pole Ceiling Mount is a professional-grade solution for suspending large-format displays from structural ceilings in retail, corporate, and public venues. It supports 43" to 86" landscape-oriented displays up to 132 lb (60 kg) and provides controlled tilt, swivel, and rotation for precise alignment in high-traffic environments.Designed for AV installers and facilities teams, this mount delivers structural rigidity, VESA-wide compatibility, and compliance documentation suitable for enterprise and government projects.Rated for 132 lb (60 kg) maximum load; steel long-pole structure distributes weight vertically into the ceiling anchor plateCompatible with VESA mounting patterns from 200×200 to 600×400Telescoping pole assembly with adjustable vertical drop of approximately 51.4" to 74.9"Post-installation tilt (-25° to 0°), level (±3°), swivel (±60°), and rotation (±180°) adjustmentSteel construction with reinforced joints for indoor commercial useProfessional installation and periodic inspection requiredCompliant with RoHS, REACH, EU POP, TSCA 6(h), and California Prop 65Suited for retail signage, lobbies, and conference rooms SUPPORTS LARGE, HEAVY DISPLAYS SAFELYRated for 132 lb (60 kg) maximum load, the steel long-pole structure distributes weight vertically into the ceiling anchor plate, reducing shear stress at the display interface. This load rating is defined in the approved specification and user manual. WIDE VESA COMPATIBILITY FOR INSTALLER FLEXIBILITYCompatible with VESA® mounting patterns from 200×200 to 600×400, covering the majority of 43"-86" flat or curved landscape displays used in signage and conference environments. LONG-POLE DROP WITH FINE HEIGHT ADJUSTMENTThe telescoping pole assembly provides an adjustable vertical drop range of approximately 51.4" to 74.9" (1305-1905 mm ±15 mm) measured from ceiling plate to display interface, enabling alignment with sightlines in retail aisles and lobbies. POST-INSTALLATION DISPLAY ADJUSTMENTTilt: -25° to 0°. Level adjustment: ±3°. Swivel: ±60°. Rotation: ±180°. These adjustments allow correction for ceiling irregularities and viewing-angle optimization without removing the display. COMMERCIAL-GRADE INDOOR CONSTRUCTIONSteel construction with reinforced joints is intended for indoor commercial use only, as stated in the safety and installation guidelines. Professional installation and periodic inspection are required. PACKAGE CONTENTS• Ceiling mounting plate• Telescoping steel pole sections• Display mounting rails and brackets• Full hardware kit (anchors, bolts, spacers)• Installation manual .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}Lifetime WarrantyWith Monoprice's Lifetime Warranty, you can rest assured we stand behind our products and our customers.
